name: Telekinetic Attacks, Mass
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 4, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Targets one touched weapon/2 levels

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as telekinetic attacks except it affects multiple weapons.
